text:
anya: Running into a weird parity issue in the TypeScript SDK when using jsonMode + schema strictness. Tool schema uses oneOf: [array, null] for optional entity list. TS SDK helper coerces `undefined` -> null on the function-call arguments, but the JSON-mode sender converts an empty array to `[]` and our validator complains oneOf mismatch during onboarding. Short repro below.

ravi: Can you paste the tool schema and the failing payload?

anya: Tool schema snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "annotate_tokens",
  "parameters": {
    "oneOf": [
      { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object" } },
      { "type": "null" }
    ]
  }
}
```

Observed payload sent by TS SDK in jsonMode:
```
function_call: { name: 'annotate_tokens', arguments: { tokens: null } }
```
But the handler expects an array or null at top-level arguments (i.e., `arguments` should be either `[]` or `null`), not `{ tokens: null }`. Validator: `expected array or null at /parameters; got object`.

pat: Hmm, looks like the helper that maps named parameters into an arguments object wraps top-level arrays when there are named params. Python SDK flattens when schema is oneOf array|null and argument name matches. Parity gap.

anya: Quick workaround in sample-app: accept both shapes and coerce `{tokens: null} -> null` or `{tokens: []} -> []`. But that hides the mismatch.

docs-bot: Note: please add a docs note about schema shapes for function-call arguments when using `oneOf` at top-level. Many quickstarts assume positional arrays.

ravi: I think the right fix is: when the tool parameters schema is a top-level array or union including array/null, SDK should serialize `arguments` as the raw array/null instead of wrapping into an object keyed by parameter name. Add an SDK unit test asserting parity with Python behavior for oneOf cases.

ci-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-980 "ts-sdk: function-call argument wrapping breaks oneOf(array|null) schemas in jsonMode" (labels: bug, sdk-parity).

pat: I'll open a tiny PR to change the serializer to detect `parameters.oneOf` with array/null and avoid named wrapper. Adding sample-kit e2e to validate quickstart doesn't regress.

anya: Thanks. I'll merge the sample-app shim for now so new users don't hit this during onboarding, and we'll revert once SDK patch lands.

ravi: Great. Also add a linter rule in the CLI that warns when a tool schema declares a top-level array union but sample handler uses named params. That'll save folks confusion.

anya: Agreed. Marking DEVEX-980 blocked on TS SDK patch + sample-kit test.
